head_commit.message:
Compose current Freight main with qualified Utility source records

Actor: chatgpt:68094585a1c2 / root. Preserve the Utility source and 98 author evidence files from 08af0d16 unchanged while incorporating current main 39ea75b0, including Freight PR #57. Full-tree readback verifies 1,428 leaves, 110 allowed Utility contribution paths and all 1,318 other current-main leaves exactly. This current composition requires existing hosted qualification; the independent native receiving and author Chromium evidence remain bound to unchanged Utility bytes. No native suite or browser rerun.
